name: CompShare Provider
description: Registers UCloud CompShare (优云智算 ModelVerse) GLM 5.3 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash as an OpenClaw provider over the OpenAI Responses API. Supports the China mainland pay-as-you-go endpoint, the Agent Plan (Coding Plan) endpoint and the overseas endpoint.

region.description: Which CompShare deployment to call: cn = China mainland (api.modelverse.cn, plus cp.compshare.cn for the Agent Plan), overseas = outside China (api.umodelverse.ai).

surface.description: Billing surface for the China mainland region: api = pay-as-you-go (api.modelverse.cn, billed per token), plan = Agent Plan / Coding Plan (cp.compshare.cn, needs the plan-specific key). The plan endpoint does not exist outside China, so region=overseas falls back to the overseas pay-as-you-go endpoint.

baseUrl.description: Explicit base URL override. When set it wins over region/surface. Useful for a proxy or for a future endpoint that is not in the built-in table.
